<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Inconsistent data and access issues",
 "problem_statement": "Users see mismatched numbers despite submitting correct data, and role assignments appear accurate but still block proper access. This undermines trust in the platform's accuracy and usability."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-10-01",
 "accounts_n": 2,
 "mentions_n": 2,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "support": 2
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 215000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 0,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Duncastle Auto",
   "arr_gbp": 80000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-08-19",
   "mentions": 1
  },
  {
   "name": "Ormsgill Cyber",
   "arr_gbp": 135000.0,
   "renewal_date": null,
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "fc524069d591a3aa",
  "quote": "everything looks correct, but the numbers still don’t match what we submitted last week.",
  "account": "Duncastle Auto",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-09-03T13:25:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "fecead1bb8254bea",
  "quote": "I’m under the impression I’m assigned the right role, but maybe something’s misconfigured on our end.",
  "account": "Ormsgill Cyber",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-10-28T08:26:00+00:00"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{"body_md": "## Problem
Users experience mismatched data outputs despite submitting correct inputs, and encounter access issues even when role assignments appear accurate. This undermines trust in the platform's accuracy and usability.

## Who is affected
- Two accounts have reported this problem via the support route [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].

## Evidence
- The problem has been reported 2 times [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].
- All 2 mentions came through the support route [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].
- One account, Duncastle Auto, reported that everything looks correct, but the numbers still don’t match what we submitted last week [i:fc524069d591a3aa].
- Another account, Ormsgill Cyber, reported being under the impression of having the right role, but suggested something might be misconfigured [i:fecead1bb8254bea].
- The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the affected accounts is £215,000.0 [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].
- Duncastle Auto contributes £80,000.0 of ARR and has a renewal date of 2027-08-19 [i:fc524069d591a3aa].
- Ormsgill Cyber contributes £135,000.0 of ARR [i:fecead1bb8254bea].
- There have been 0 renewals in the last 90 days [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].

## Why now
- The most recent report was made on 2026-10-28 [i:fecead1bb8254bea].
- An earlier report was made on 2026-09-03 [i:fc524069d591a3aa].
- The fact sheet data is current as of 2026-10-01, indicating the issue is active and unresolved [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].", "citations": ["fc524069d591a3aa", "fecead1bb8254bea"]}
